head: Private photos.
Locked away.
vault.sub: An encrypted vault with your own code.

head: You decide what
gets deleted.
decide.sub: Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

head: Not sure yet?
Decide later.
later.sub: It comes back when you are ready.

head: Try a new look.
Keep the original.
editor.sub: Edits are saved as a separate copy.

head: Take a break.
Play a little.
pairs.sub: Match pairs with your own photos.

head: A little every day.
See your progress.
today.sub: A daily goal that fits your pace.
